claude_subagents.name: classify-demand
claude_subagents.description: Classify a demand as fast, standard, or complex. MUST be the first action on every new demand, before any file is created, changed, or any state-changing command runs.

claude_subagents.name: research
claude_subagents.tools: Read, Write, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, WebSearch
claude_subagents.description: Produce a concise research brief before spec writing, for complex demands needing investigation, including whether an existing library already solves the problem. Receives only topic and scope — no prior agent context.

claude_subagents.name: spec-to-tasks
claude_subagents.description: Decompose a spec into atomic, independently verifiable tasks and emit the task_plan.

claude_subagents.name: executor
claude_subagents.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
claude_subagents.description: Implement tasks under the contract section of the task_plan and emit an execution_report with evidence. Receives only task_plan.

claude_subagents.name: tester
claude_subagents.description: Validate an execution_report against the task_plan ## Contract section and emit a compliance_report. Receives only task_plan, execution_report, and codebase.

claude_subagents.name: security-gate-owasp
claude_subagents.description: Gate security-relevant changes against the OWASP Top 10:2025 categories. Dispatched alongside tester when domain is security or changed files touch auth, crypto, input handling, access control, or dependency manifests. Receives only changed_files and task_plan.

claude_subagents.name: architecture-evaluation
claude_subagents.description: Evaluate architecture before task decomposition using state, flow, computation, failure and trust-boundary analysis; persist trade-offs and validation criteria.

claude_subagents.name: defensive-pentest
claude_subagents.description: Run an authorized, local defensive pentest and optional chaos day only for a final candidate, reporting exploited failures by damage level with evidence and recovery results.

claude_subagents.name: remediator
claude_subagents.description: Turn compliance failures into a minimal fix plan and mark impacted tasks for rework. Receives only compliance_report, task_plan, execution_report.

claude_subagents.name: historian
claude_subagents.description: Append one factual iteration entry to the run state. Structured write only, no reasoning.

claude_subagents.name: blind-review
claude_subagents.description: Review changed files cold, without spec or task context, and emit a blind review report. Receives only changed_files and adjacent_modules.

claude_subagents.name: documenter
claude_subagents.description: Update docs from validated behavior after zero blocker and zero major findings. Structured write only.

claude_skills.name: classify-demand
claude_skills.description: Classify a demand as fast, standard, or complex. Use as the first action on any new demand, before creating, changing, or running anything that changes project state.

claude_skills.name: research
claude_skills.description: Produce a concise research brief before spec writing, including checking whether an existing library or tool already solves the problem. Use for demands that need investigation before decomposition.

claude_skills.name: spec-to-tasks
claude_skills.description: Break a spec into atomic, independently verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria. Use once a spec (and research brief, if any) is ready to decompose.

claude_skills.name: execute-tasks-with-contract
claude_skills.description: Execute a task plan sequentially under an implementation contract, collecting evidence per task. Use once a task_plan and contract both exist.

claude_skills.name: non-conformity-reconciliation
claude_skills.description: Turn tester or blind-review findings into a minimal remediation plan and mark impacted tasks for rework. Use whenever a compliance_report has non_conformities greater than 0.

claude_skills.name: implementation-history-sync
claude_skills.description: Append one factual iteration entry to a run's state file. Use after execution and testing, before deciding whether to loop again.

claude_skills.name: blind-review
claude_skills.description: Review changed files cold, with no spec or task context, to surface issues a spec-aware pass might miss. Use after non_conformities reach 0, before documentation update.

claude_skills.name: documentation-update-sync
claude_skills.description: Sync project docs with the final validated behavior after a clean compliance and blind review. Use as the last step before closing a run.

claude_skills.name: security-gate-owasp
claude_skills.description: Gate security-relevant changes against the OWASP Top 10:2025 categories before a run can close. Use whenever domain is security, or changed files touch auth, crypto, input handling, access control, or dependency manifests.

claude_skills.name: architecture-evaluation
claude_skills.description: Evaluate architecture before task decomposition using state, flow, computation, failure and trust-boundary analysis; persist trade-offs and validation criteria.

claude_skills.name: defensive-pentest
claude_skills.description: Run an authorized, local defensive pentest and optional chaos day only for a final candidate, reporting exploited failures by damage level with evidence and recovery results.

claude_skills.name: caveman
claude_skills.description: This project's default ultra-compressed communication style. Reads the active level from .agentic/state/caveman.json (default: full). Use to check or explain the active communication level, or when asked to change it.

claude_skills.name: issue-lifecycle
claude_skills.description: Create, claim, track, and close a GitHub issue for every standard/complex demand. Call create after classify, update after each major phase, and close before marking the run completed.
